title: Word to Bits
text: 将实数转换为位向量，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；{Maximum Word Length} 指定 Maximum output word length、{Output bit order} 输出位顺序 LSB，按实例取值。

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 binary-valued scalar | binary-valued vector

params.name: Maximum Word Length
params.values: Maximum output word length 64 (default) | integer in the range [1, 65535]

params.name: Output bit order
params.values: 输出位顺序 LSB first (default) | MSB first
